svg.title: Exclusive SIES destinations
svg.desc: Exclusive SIES destinations. Historical definition. SIES destinations in the 2 years after expected school completion. Adjusted difference (pp). Nominal uncertainty interval: 98.75 %. No observed SIES record: +2.3 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE; University only: −2.1 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE; IP/CFT only: −0.3 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE; University and IP/CFT: +0.1 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE.
